paper.title_en: Measurement of $\Lambda/\bar{\Lambda}$ Transverse Polarization within Jets in $pp$ Collisions at $\sqrt{s}=510$ GeV
paper.abstract_en: The transverse polarization of $\Lambda$ hyperons produced in unpolarized hadron–hadron collisions, first observed decades ago, remains not fully understood. Polarizing Fragmentation Functions are widely regarded as a natural framework to describe this phenomenon and can be probed through measurements of the transverse polarization of $\Lambda/\overline{\Lambda}$ hyperons inside jets in $pp$ collisions, where the jet serves as a proxy for the fragmenting parton. In this contribution, we report preliminary results on $\Lambda/\overline{\Lambda}$ transverse polarization within jets in $pp$ collisions at $\sqrt{s}=510~\mathrm{GeV}$, using data collected by the STAR detector at RHIC in 2017. Comparisons with measurements at different collision energies in $pp$ collisions and with results from $e^+e^-$ annihilation enable studies of the energy-scale dependence and tests of the universality of polarizing Fragmentation Functions.
